name: Capital benefit of CHF 500,000, Bellinzona, men's table
workings: A capital benefit of 500,000.00 alone in the year (a BVG lump sum).
Federal: 1/5 of the tariff (at most 11.5% of the amount): 10,500.6880.
Ticino: the annuity it buys (50.77 per 1,000, table male) rounded down to 100: 25,300; the tariff's average rate on it 2.5896%, kept between 2% and 3%: 2.5896%; simple tax 12,948.0040.
A secondary comparison gives CHF 35,491 for Bellinzona; with the official table's 478.65 at 20,800 the cantonal and communal tax is 24,990.26 against 24,990.31 there.
